says: The Config was created, migrated or changed.
A model was created in `Uploading`.
Additional Weights accounts were bound to an uploading model.
Ciphertext bytes were written.
A batch of 65,552-byte ciphertext chunks was hashed into the model's Merkle frontier.
A model's ciphertext root hash was fixed.
A model's price, mint, operator share or price unit changed.
A model's allowed measurements list changed.
A model became `Live` or `Retired`.
An enclave was registered or refreshed.
A grant was written or revoked.
A call opened with its escrow.
A call settled and its receipt was written.
A call's escrow returned to the caller.
A 48-byte enclave measurement was published with its source commit and recipe hash.
A published measurement was marked `Deprecated`.
A model's on-chain Policy PDA was created or updated.
A model's on-chain Policy PDA was closed and cleared.
An enclave operator set or cleared a quoted operator share on a Grant.
A new ModelVersion PDA was created in `Uploading` while the model stayed live.
A ModelVersion was finalized and atomically flipped live on the Model, carrying the prior version snapshot.
A funded Session PDA was created authorizing a delegate until `expires_at_slot`.
Escrow was debited from a Session PDA to open a delegated call.
A Session PDA was closed and its unspent budget returned to `caller`.
A model's Split PDA was created, updated, or deactivated.
Settled `owner_amount` was routed into a model's Split PDA and credited across recipients.
Accrued split balance (`accrued - claimed`) was paid out to a recipient wallet.
An enclave operator deposited SOL into the enclave's Bond PDA.
An enclave operator withdrew unslashed SOL from the enclave's Bond PDA.
A timed-out call slashed the enclave's Bond PDA and paid the slash directly to `call.caller`.
A verifiable receipt-backed Benchmark PDA was published for a model.
A model's prepaid PassPlan PDA was created, updated, or deactivated.
A caller purchased a prepaid Pass PDA funded with `calls_total * price_per_call`.
One prepaid call was debited from a Pass PDA to open a discounted Call.
A Pass PDA was closed and its remaining escrow returned to `holder`.
A model's ReferralConfig PDA was created, updated, or deactivated.
An open Call was attributed to a referrer wallet via a CallReferral PDA.
A settled referred call carved `floor(owner_amount * share_bps / 10_000)` into the referrer's Referral PDA.
Accrued referral balance (`total_earned - claimed`) was paid out to the referrer wallet.
